comment: Measured nondeterminism for scripts/ci/tmux-census.py compare --rules. Each rule covers a timing loop or teardown race that recordings of one unchanged commit showed; keep them narrow and cite the source. Collapse merges back-to-back repeats of read-only observation calls only, so commands that change state keep their exact order and count.

replace.calls: (list-panes -a -F .*\[exit 1;.*) stderr="(?:no current target|no server running on [^"]*|server exited unexpectedly)"$
replace.why: src/state/lifecycle.rs: pause polls panes until the agent exits; the last list-panes reaches tmux either while the empty server is shutting down (no current target) or after it exited (3 of 24 loaded repeats of test_pause on main), or while it exits (server exited unexpectedly: test_pause.Rename in 1 of 2 concurrent full recordings)
which resumed supervisor's pane races the test's kill-server (see the any_count rule) varies: %1 completed in one recording of main and raced in the next

collapse.why: src/state/questions.rs and codex_goal_resume.rs: answer polls the input state and screen (80 ms) until the provider confirms
src/state/clear_context.rs and compact_context.rs: poll the chooser and input line every 40 ms until /clear or /compact is ready
src/state/effort.rs: wait_until and the model picker poll the screen every 50 ms until the provider shows the change
src/state/interrupt.rs: settle_claude captures the screen every 60 ms until Claude shows the interruption
src/state/lifecycle.rs: pause lists panes every 100 ms until the agent exits

optional.calls: \[exit 1;.*stderr="(?:no server running on |server exited unexpectedly|lost server)
optional.why: an agent's hook or supervisor can still run while the test kills its tmux server; tmux then fails at a timing-dependent call with one of these messages

any_count.why: tests/test_pause.py GitContext polls hgs ls until the branch name changes
the fake agents in these classes report hooks while the test stops them; whether the last hook runs depends on timing (also 303 to 305 hooks in loaded repeats of test_pause Archive and Lifecycle)
a resumed supervisor either tags its pane before the test kills the server or races that kill (dropped by the optional rule): 10 or 11 complete ones in loaded repeats
